question: What is the total revenue of the health_beauty category?
sql:
WITH health_items AS (
    SELECT oi.price, oi.freight_value
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND ct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
)
SELECT SUM(price + freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM health_items
